description: Switched in at runtime once the key is stored (TC-411; the switch is #2893's), so its scenario time starts at the switch. Healthy for 10 s after the switch; from 10 s to 30 s after it the private WS drops and refuses reconnects and every REST call answers HTTP 503; from 30 s everything recovers as compliant.

expected.outcome: Watched for 60 s from T0, the switch: never red (health never down; green or amber both pass) and order entry never disabled for the 20 s outage (T0 + 10 s to T0 + 30 s).
